mentions.name: Safety Evidence
mentions.description: A website compiling the most comprehensive collection of benchmarks of the safety, ethics, and values of LLMs. It aggregates sparse safety benchmark scores into a global ranking, optimized to maximize correlation with individual benchmarks.
